symptom: the security report flags a callable flow as high (or 'reads only') although it checks the caller, or commits, in a sub-microflow it calls (Shop.DS_Info_Line on ako/PizzaV1)
cause: collectCallableFlows looked for $currentUser / [%CurrentUser%] and for change/delete/commit/create refs in the flow's own body only
insight: Anything a flow 'does' for a security verdict is a property of its call closure, not its body; the tests report's CallGraph.Closure already had it. Name the sub that supplies the check (checkedBy / writesVia) so the reader can confirm the check covers the object the page passed in
